pages.title: Soup on Legs
pages.text: Forest planks furnish a mushroom camp and escargot introduces another unusual edible resource.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find Flukeshrooms in Mushroom Fields. Use an empty bowl and receive soup. Lightning changes their form, but waiting for a storm is optional.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Explore Spawn Overworld biomes, animals and ambient features. Mod-wide exploration activities beyond item collection.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Milk Flukeshroom with a bowl and account for lightning transformation. The Mushroom Fields creature provides soup and changes form when struck.
